capture_bonus.name: Trophy Case
capture_bonus.desc: Pieces you capture are worth +1 point. Your own pieces are worth +1 points too.

holes.name: Sinkholes
holes.desc: 2-4 holes appear in the middle rows. Only knights can jump over them.

exploding.name: Powder Keg
exploding.desc: Pieces you capture explode, also capturing every adjacent piece (yours too). No chain reactions.
